eps.ov: Kurumi enters the world of forex to prove she can succeed where her mother once failed.
After some advice from her friend Mochiko, Kurumi takes a risky position trading the Australian dollar.

eps.t: Do I Have to Cut My Losses…?
eps.ov: AUD/JPY takes Kurumi on a wild ride, and she finds herself at risk of losing all the money she "borrowed."

eps.t: Having No Unrealized Losses Is the Best
eps.ov: Kurumi has an awkward confrontation with her dad, and then gets roped into teaching forex to a new investor.

eps.t: Long? Short? Which Do I Choose?
eps.ov: Kurumi quits forex and tries hard to find a new hobby, but the temptation to start trading again is strong.
Mebuki attempts to trade forex without Kurumi's help, but does she know enough about how the markets work?

eps.t: I Don't Wanna Have a Forced Liquidation...
eps.ov: The girls begin an investment competition, all while Mebuki clings tenaciously to her risky short position.

eps.t: Monetary Easing Is a Wild Party
eps.ov: After losing all her initial funds, Mebuki resorts to borrowing money to maintain a short position on USD/JPY.
Mebuki asks Mochiko to loan her additional funds, and Mochiko insists on a few strict conditions.
